description: This file contains extension methods for creating and initializing shape objects within the OrchardCore.DisplayManagement namespace, including support for dynamic proxy generation and shape property copying.

classes.name: ShapeFactoryExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for creating and initializing shape objects, including support for proxies and property copying.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new shape asynchronously, optionally copying properties from a model or initializing with a function.

methods.name: CreateStronglyTypedShape
methods.description: Creates a shape instance with a dynamic proxy if the base type does not implement IShape.
